name: Unified Account (Buy & Sell)
description: One account — any user can both buy and sell. No separate buyer/seller logins; the listing decides the role.

name: Mobile OTP Login
description: Sign up / log in with mobile + OTP. Real JWT sessions.

name: User Profile
description: Name, photo, city, category interests, and contact-visibility settings (public / on-request / hidden).

name: Verified & TrustSEAL Badges
description: Admin-granted verification and trust badges to build buyer confidence.

name: Gamified Badges
description: Auto-earned Top Rated (4.5+ star) and Fast Responder (≤2h) badges.

name: Post a Listing
description: List a product or a service with photos, price, description, category, and location.

name: Products & Services
description: One catalog handles physical products (price/MOQ/specs) and services (rate-card/credentials/service-area).

name: Edit / Mark as Sold
description: Sellers update, deactivate, or mark their listings Sold.

name: Item Condition
description: New / Used condition on product listings.

name: AI Listing Auto-fill
description: Auto-writes title, description, and category from an uploaded photo (Claude vision).

name: Browse & Faceted Search
description: Search with filters: category, price tiers, city, verified, condition, type.

name: AI Search Concierge
description: Type a natural request ("CA in Pune for GST filing") — AI returns matches or routes to the right page.

name: Voice Input for AI Search
description: Speak your query instead of typing (browser voice).

name: Near-Me / Distance
description: Distance-sorted results from your city + radius filter.

name: Map View
description: Toggle listings/businesses onto an interactive map (OpenStreetMap).

name: Category Landing Pages
description: Dedicated page per category with nested sub-categories (250+ nodes, 5 levels deep).

name: City Pages & Trending
description: City-scoped pages showing trending listings/businesses.

name: Business Profile Page
description: Name, category, services, hours, photos, map location, reviews, and trust badges.

name: Call / WhatsApp / Chat
description: One-tap contact from any profile or listing.

name: Follow Sellers & Businesses
description: Follow to get notified of new listings and stories.

name: 24-Hour Stories
description: Post photo/video that disappears after 24h, linked to a listing/profile.

name: Story View Counts
description: Sellers see how many people viewed each story.

name: Story Highlights
description: Pin best stories permanently to a profile.

name: In-App Chat
description: Secure buyer↔seller messaging; contact number not shared until agreed.

name: Notification Center
description: In-app alerts for messages, story views, new followers.

name: Share to WhatsApp
description: One-tap share of listings/stories via WhatsApp + copy-link.

name: Two-Way Ratings & Reviews
description: Buyers and sellers rate each other after an interaction.

name: Report Listing
description: Flag suspicious/fraudulent listings for admin review.

name: Moderation Queue
description: Admins review reports, resolve or dismiss.

name: Seller Blogs
description: Sellers publish SEO articles/guides for organic reach.

name: Multi-Language (EN / हिन्दी)
description: Language toggle for wider tier-2/3 reach.

name: Referral Program
description: Invite friends for listing-boost credits.

name: Featured / Boosted Listings
description: Sellers pay to rank higher in category/city/search (labeled Sponsored).

name: Business Subscription Plans
description: Free / Silver / Gold tiers unlock listings, leads, badges, analytics.

name: Lead-Gen (Pay per Inquiry)
description: Businesses receive/pay for qualified inquiries (JustDial-style).

name: In-App Ads
description: Sponsored banner/slots on home, category, and city pages.

name: Seller Analytics
description: Performance dashboard for paid sellers.

name: Admin Dashboard
description: Moderate listings/stories/reports, manage sellers, view analytics.

name: Monetization Controls
description: Set featured/boost, assign plans, ad bookings, mark payments paid.

name: Features Catalog
description: This living list — so the sales team always knows what the platform sells.

name: Self-Serve Advertising
description: Create and run your own ad campaigns from the dashboard.
